# ProMe — Game Companion

ProMe is a free, open-source digital companion app for “The Protector’s Memories,” a solo tabletop RPG by Enzo Salviato (published by Critical Kit). Available in English and French. Works offline as a PWA; character data is stored locally with optional sync via Google login (through Netlify Identity).

## Core Functionality

The core of ProMe is the character sheet, a personal dashboard for a Protector character. It is not a static URL — each character lives at `/en/characters/[id]` (or `/fr/personnages/[id]`) and is tied to the player’s local storage (or synced account). The sheet tracks:

- Stats: Soul, Stamina, Courage, Honor, Inspiration, Coins
- An interactive hex map of the world with color-coded biomes, updated as the Protector explores
- A markdown journal that auto-populates entries from map moves, dice rolls, and card draws
- Inventory and spellbook
- A game clock tied to the Stamina stat

## Generators

- [NPC Generator](https://prome.games/en/generators/npc) — Procedurally generate non-player characters with traits, faction, and roleplay hooks
- [Town Generator](https://prome.games/en/generators/village) — Procedurally generate towns with inhabitants, layout, and points of interest

## Biomes

Six explorable environments from the rulebook, each with distinct mechanics and atmosphere:

- [Shadow Woods](https://prome.games/en/biomes/shadow-woods)
- [Sunken Savannah](https://prome.games/en/biomes/sunken-savannah)
- [Mushroom Jungle](https://prome.games/en/biomes/mushroom-jungle)
- [Prairie Sea](https://prome.games/en/biomes/prairie-sea)
- [Silent Wastes](https://prome.games/en/biomes/silent-wastes)
- [Titan Garden](https://prome.games/en/biomes/titan-garden)
